scope: Batch 11 extraction from untagged Tarkir side stories (2014-2015 Khans/Fate Reforged/Dragons of Tarkir and a 2026 Dragonstorm story) plus the 2014 Sarkhan and Ob Nixilis primers. Khans-era and Dragons-era claims belong to different timelines; Unwritten is set in Tarkir's past. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.

claims.subject: surrak

quotes.quote: Now he is the Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan, who hunt to feed their dragonlord.

claims.summary: In the Dragons of Tarkir timeline, Surrak is the Hunt Caller of the Atarka clan, which hunts to feed Dragonlord Atarka (rewritten timeline, 2015).
claims.limitation: The sentence names the Atarka clan and its dragonlord; Surrak's service to Atarka herself is inferred from his role.

claims.subject: tasigur

quotes.quote: My khan, one does not summon Khudal.
more Sultai citizens welcomed the arrival of enemy forces

claims.summary: Tasigur is addressed as khan while defending the Sultai (Fate Reforged, Tarkir's past, 2015).
claims.limitation: The page addresses Tasigur as khan and shows him defending Sultai lands; it does not state the title in narration. Set in Tarkir's past.

claims.subject: anafenza

quotes.quote: Although Anafenza was barely visible through the maelstrom of dust, Oret could still hear his captain

claims.summary: Oret serves under his captain Anafenza (original timeline, story set as Anafenza falls, 2015).

claims.subject: sidisi

quotes.quote: She approached Silumgar's throne, loudly making a path through the gold coins
Before, when Sidisi was still alive, the dragon's breath burned her skin.

claims.summary: Undead Sidisi attends Dragonlord Silumgar's court (rewritten timeline, 2015).
claims.limitation: The page shows undead Sidisi at Silumgar's court; her formal role is not named in the excerpted lines.

claims.subject: kuhnde

quotes.quote: Atop a red-roofed Jeskai tower, a monk named Kuhnde stood on his mantis and looked over the valley.

claims.summary: Kuhnde is a Jeskai monk and mantis rider (2014).

claims.subject: riza

quotes.quote: Riza, the patrol captain, said to his top lieutenants
moving ever farther from the safety and civilization of the Abzan territories

claims.summary: Riza captains a patrol on the Salt Road away from Abzan territory (2014).
claims.limitation: Riza's Abzan allegiance is inferred from the story's framing of Abzan and Mardu patrol leaders.

claims.subject: yasova_dragonclaw

quotes.quote: Yasova Dragonclaw of the Temur pays her respects to you, O khan of khans
May I ask you something, Yasova khan?

claims.summary: Yasova Dragonclaw is khan of the Temur in Tarkir's past, when Sarkhan meets her (2015).
claims.limitation: Set years in Tarkir's past; addressed as khan in dialogue. Not the Khans-era present leader.

claims.subject: vasi

quotes.quote: Vasi's style is uncommon among Dromoka's brood, relying on her speed and precision.

claims.summary: Vasi belongs to Dromoka's brood (Tarkir: Dragonstorm era, 2026).
claims.limitation: Modelled as membership of Dromoka's brood with Dromoka as the object; no separate brood entity exists.

claims.subject: sarkhan_vol

quotes.quote: He eventually ran afoul of the one of the oldest and most powerful dragons in existence: the ancient and malevolent elder dragon Planeswalker, Nicol Bolas.

claims.summary: Sarkhan Vol ran afoul of Nicol Bolas (as of 2014).
claims.limitation: 'Ran afoul of' is rendered as enmity; the primer does not detail the conflict.

claims.subject: sarkhan_vol

quotes.quote: Born on a windswept, war-torn world where dragons are extinct, he became a Planeswalker as a young man

claims.summary: Sarkhan Vol was born on a war-torn world where dragons are extinct (Tarkir, as of 2014).
claims.limitation: The primer sentence does not name the world; the page names Tarkir elsewhere.

claims.subject: ob_nixilis

quotes.quote: He was once a Planeswalker, until he was stripped of his spark and trapped on the wild-mana plane of Zendikar thousands of years ago.

claims.summary: Ob Nixilis was stripped of his spark and trapped on Zendikar thousands of years ago (as of 2014).
